card.name: Inside organization names and titles
card.fires_on: Small words or marks inside or right after an organization's name or a job title, where a noun like office, service, center, or company is expected next. Examples are 'the' after 'coordinator for', "'s" after JURIST, and 'Media' after MultiVu.

modes.label: Possessive or 'the' after a role
modes.description: A small word after a person's role or a group name, before the thing the group runs or covers.
modes.example: the head of JURIST<<'s>> student commentary service

modes.label: Partway through an organization name
modes.description: A word or mark inside a company or institution name, with the rest of the name still to come.
modes.example: Mickschl, who works at Midwest<< Children>>’s Resource Center

card.writes: It pushes toward word pieces that continue a name, and away from generic words like headquarters, agencies and organizations.
card.plain: It fires inside the names of organizations and in job titles, where more of the name is about to follow.
